speech.title: Speech models
speech.intro: Speech models run inside ChatonLM, not in Ollama. Dictation uses the one you choose.

parakeet_tdt_0_6b_v3.description: Fast and accurate, with punctuation. Detects the language automatically. Runs well without a GPU.

whisper_tiny.description: Smallest and fastest Whisper model. Rough accuracy.

whisper_small.description: Good balance of speed and accuracy.

whisper_large_v3_turbo.description: Most accurate Whisper model here. Slow without a GPU.

speech.unsupported: Not available on this computer: Whisper needs instructions its processor lacks ({features}).

runtime.missing: Not available: ONNX Runtime, which Parakeet needs, is missing ({detail}). Reinstall ChatonLM.
runtime.incompatible: Not available: the ONNX Runtime found can't run Parakeet ({detail}). Reinstall ChatonLM.
runtime.loadFailed: Not available: ONNX Runtime, which Parakeet needs, could not be loaded ({detail}).

speech.deleteText: This removes the model files from this computer. You can download it again later.
speech.deleteTextInUse: This removes the model files from this computer. Dictation won't work until you download it again or choose another speech model.

voices.title: Voices
voices.intro: Voices read responses aloud. They run inside ChatonLM, not in Ollama.
voices.basedOn: Based on <link>{source}</link> by Kyutai, licensed under {license}. Exported to ONNX and quantized by ChatonLM.

runtime.missing: Not available: ONNX Runtime, which reading aloud needs, is missing ({detail}). Reinstall ChatonLM.
runtime.incompatible: Not available: the ONNX Runtime found can't run reading aloud ({detail}). Reinstall ChatonLM.
runtime.loadFailed: Not available: ONNX Runtime, which reading aloud needs, could not be loaded ({detail}).

voices.deleteText: This removes the voice from this computer. You can download it again later.

images.title: Image models
images.intro: Image models create pictures from your descriptions in a chat. They run inside ChatonLM, not in Ollama.

howTo.title: How it works
howTo.chat: In a chat, press the Image button (or ask the model for a picture)

machine.noEngine: This version of ChatonLM doesn't include the image engine. You can download models, but not create images.
machine.missingCpu: This computer can't create images: its processor lacks instructions the image engine needs ({features}).
machine.noGpu: No graphics card found: images will be made by the processor, which takes several minutes each.

images.noResults: No image models match your search.
images.noCompatible: No compatible image models match your search.

repoCard.restricted: Restricted: needs a Hugging Face account

images.uncensoredHint: This model can create explicit or shocking images.
images.toDownloadShared: {size} to download ({present} already on this computer)
images.quantHint: File variant. Q4: lighter, a little less faithful · Q8: more faithful, heavier

families.flux2-klein-4b: Fast and versatile, good at text in pictures. A good first choice.
families.flux2-klein-base-4b: Base version of klein 4B: slower and more varied, for experiments.
families.flux2-klein-9b: Bigger klein: more detail and closer to your description, but heavier and slower.
families.z-image-turbo: Photorealistic pictures and good text, quick.
families.z-image: Full version of Z-Image: slower, more varied.
families.flux1-schnell: Fast FLUX.1 model for everyday pictures.
families.chroma: Open model based on FLUX, many styles, slow.
families.qwen-image: Very good at text and complex scenes; heavy and slow.
families.sdxl: Classic Stable Diffusion XL: many styles and variants, light.
families.sd15: Older, very light Stable Diffusion 1.5: modest quality, runs almost anywhere.

speed.measuredHint: Time of the last picture made on this computer

memory.hint: Graphics card memory needed for one 1024×1024 picture

images.deleteText: This removes the model from this computer. Files it shares with your other image models are kept.
images.deleteTextInUse: This removes the model from this computer. Image generation won't work until you download it again or choose another image model.

polish.intro: A second model cleans up the transcript: punctuation, filler words, self-corrections. If its answer does not look like what you said, the raw transcript is copied instead.
polish.unreachable: Ollama is unreachable. Start it to download or use these models.
polish.label: Polish models
polish.anyModel: Any installed model can be chosen in Settings.
